sites.source: MN DNR feature detail sft00009, facility cmp00007 (camping: fee 1, campsites 10) + cmp00007.pdf (sites 1-10 on one loop), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: MN DNR facility cmp00007 ('The campsites are considered "primitive," designed to furnish only the basic needs of the camper. The campsites consist of a cleared area, fire ring, a table, vault toilets, garbage cans, and hand-pump drinking water'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: MN DNR facility cmp00007 ('vault toilets, garbage cans, and hand-pump drinking water') + cmp00007.pdf (Vault Toilet and Drinking Water symbols in the loop), read 2026-11-11

values.note: First come, first served; the fee is paid online on the day of arrival (or at a state park ranger station) before taking a site.

booking.source: https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/fees-reservations.html ('you may not pay ahead for camping on a future date'; 'Upon arrival at the campground, choose an unoccupied campsite'; 'Beginning in 2026, state forest camping fees are paid before you occupy a campsite'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Minnesota state forest drive-in campsite, taxes included. Paid online on the arrival date or at a state park ranger station; nothing is collected at the campground. DNR state forest fee page, read 2026-11-11.

fees.source: https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/fees-reservations.html ('Individual and equestrian campsites $17 - $22'; 'Fees include taxes'; 'DNR does not accept self-payment envelopes on site or mail-in payments'), read 2026-11-11

note: Remote rustic DNR state-forest campground in pines near Cottonwood Lake, reached by gravel forest roads northeast of Deer River; a separate boat landing on the lake. Managed by the DNR Parks and Trails Grand Rapids area office. --Claude
summary: DNR facility cmp00007 read: 10 primitive sites, vault toilet, hand-pump water, 'close to Cottonwood Lake, but not right on the water' (not waterfront confirmed). Same-day online pay $17 replaces the old fee-envelope kiosk. Manager is the Parks and Trails Grand Rapids office, not Schoolcraft SP. Phone and website fixes.
flags: PHONE missing: the DNR facility lists the manager as 'Parks and Trails Grand Rapids area office', 218-328-8982. Suggest 218-328-8982.

WATERFRONT not waterfront confirmed: DNR 'The campground is close to Cottonwood Lake, but not right on the water. The campground is very wooded, mostly pine.' Map and imagery put the loop about 70-100 m from the shore behind forest and a reed fringe.
Pin 47.42811,-93.69877 is at the gate on the entrance road about 100 m west of the loop; the DNR facility point 47.427527,-93.697745 is in the loop. Optional move (under 250 m).

Note cleaned: dropped '10 primitive drive-in sites (cleared pad, fire ring, table), latrine toilets, drinking-water spigot' (fields hold them), 'First-come, first-served via fee-envelope kiosk' (booking holds FCFS; the DNR no longer accepts envelopes) and 'Managed by Schoolcraft State Park' (DNR names the Parks and Trails Grand Rapids area office).
